tips.text: Fly to the abandoned derelict and hack its cache first, every run; it has its own Nautilus drop table.
Run the Nu-gua Mines Exterminate, not Arva Vector Defense; it clears in about 6 minutes and the rotation B and C rates there are worse.
Farm under an active Void Storm; the Nautilus roll is the same but you also bank relics and other Railjack drops.
Bring a fast AoE frame such as Gyre; clearing the Corpus ship eats the clock, not the short space section.
If you grab the cache after the mission is marked complete, the part shows up after you reach the dry dock or the next mission; it is not lost.
Dock between runs; one player suspects relaunching the same node without docking does not reroll rewards.
Ask a host in recruiting chat to take you; in a premade squad only the host needs the Intrinsic rank 3 and a Railjack.
Plan on 5 to 10 hours of Neptune Proxima derelict runs for all four parts.
Players still call Nautilus with its Verglas one of the best companions; nobody argues it is weak.
